words.trans: 鼓起（脸颊、胸膛），把…吹得鼓起来（puff out one’s cheeks 鼓起腮帮子；puff out one’s chest 挺起胸膛、昂首挺胸，表示骄傲）
examples: Joel puffed out his cheeks.
He puffed out his chest proudly after winning the race.

words.trans: 电视主持人；电视节目主播
examples: Not TV presenters and football players.
She works as a TV presenter on the evening news.

words.trans: 伸手去拿；伸手够到
examples: Joel reached for the laptop.
She reached for the book on the top shelf.

words.trans: 不停地敲击（键盘）
examples: Joel tapped away at the computer.
He sat tapping away at his keyboard long after everyone had gone.

words.trans: ……真是可惜
examples: Ah, pity, there's no local address.
It's a pity that you missed the concert last night.

words.trans: 名词短语（口语，澳/美非常常用）好主意；说得对；这判断很不错
examples: 'Good call,' said Joel. 'Let's try good old Google.'
Choosing the quieter road was a good call — we avoided the jam.

words.trans: 固定口语短语（英式、澳式常用）。good old + 名词：指大家熟悉、信得过、靠谱的老熟人/老工具，带亲切感、怀旧感，不是“又好又老”的字面意思
examples: Let's try good old Google.
Nothing beats a good old cup of tea on a cold day.

words.trans: 1. 找到想要的东西/得到结果（Here we go! I found it. 找到了！）；2. 要开始做一件事（来吧，我们开始）；3. 事情发生了，略带无奈（哦又来了，他又开始吵架了）
examples: Here we go. Not just an ice cream van, but an ice cream company.
Here we go, the lesson starts now.

words.trans: 调出；显示出（页面、图片、文件）。电脑、浏览器、搜索引擎把内容加载、展示出来
examples: A few moments later he brought up the face of ponytail man.
I'll bring up the report on the screen so everyone can see.

words.trans: adj. 卡其色的；土黄色的  n. 卡其布；卡其色
examples: The man was wearing full khaki combat gear.
He wore a khaki jacket that had faded in the sun.

words.trans: 固定搭配：作战装备、战斗服
examples: Ponytail man was wearing full khaki combat gear.
The soldiers were inspected in full combat gear before the mission.

words.trans: 固定习语，偏僻荒凉、前不着村后不着店的地方
examples: It's north of here. Middle of nowhere, really.
The old farmhouse is out in the middle of nowhere, miles from any shop.

words.trans: n. 大杂烩；五花八门混杂在一起的一堆东西
examples: They hunched together to look at the hotchpotch of faces and pictures.
The exhibition was a hotchpotch of styles and periods.

words.trans: n. 班卓琴（一种弦乐器，圆形琴身、长琴颈，乡村/民谣常用）
examples: An old man with a long beard sat playing a banjo surrounded by hay bales.
He learned to play the banjo from his grandfather.

words.trans: n. 干草捆（把干草压紧捆成一大捆，农场用来喂牲畜）
examples: An old man played a banjo surrounded by hay bales.
The farmer stacked the hay bales in the barn for winter.

words.trans: （打开页面、走进某地）眼前看到、撞见、映入眼帘
examples: Joel clicked to a second page, to be greeted by banjo man again.
Opening the door, she was greeted by a cloud of warm air.

words.trans: adj.（照片、视频）颗粒感重的；有噪点的；模糊粗糙的。词根 grain 颗粒→grainy 布满颗粒的
examples: He leant close to look at the grainy face staring back at him.
The old photograph was grainy and hard to make out.

words.trans: n. 晒黑的肤色；晒出来的古铜色皮肤
examples: Look at their suntans, the dust at their feet – not grass.
He came back from Spain with a deep suntan.

words.trans: 1. 找到了；就是这儿  2. 我们到了
examples: Yes, here we are . . . it's the emblem of the Royal Signals.
Here we are at last — the station is just ahead.

words.trans: n. 徽章；标志；纹章；象征
examples: It's the emblem of the Royal Signals.
The lion is the emblem of the national football team.

words.trans: n. 胜利；大获成功；凯旋  v. 战胜；取得辉煌胜利
examples: He said with a note of triumph, 'Our Mr Clay is an expert in electronic warfare.'
They celebrated their triumph over the rival team.

words.trans: 名词短语：电子战
examples: Our Mr Clay is an expert in electronic warfare.
The unit specialised in electronic warfare and signals.

words.trans: n. 窗台；窗沿
examples: I've put it on the kitchen windowsill to dry in the sun.
She left the plant on the windowsill to catch the morning light.

words.trans: v.（鸟）嘎嘎尖叫；尖声大叫  n. 刺耳的嘎嘎叫声
examples: A loud crash was followed by the squawk and fluttering of a startled bird.
The parrot squawked loudly from its cage.

words.trans: adj. 锯齿状的；边缘参差不齐、有尖刺的
examples: Joel brought back a jagged piece of slate.
He cut his hand on a jagged piece of broken glass.

words.trans: n. 板岩；石板（深灰色岩石，常做屋顶瓦片，易裂成薄片）
examples: Joel brought back a jagged piece of slate with a skull scratched on it.
The old cottage had a roof made of grey slate.

words.trans: 骷髅头+交叉骨头，经典海盗符号；也用来表示危险、死亡警告
examples: A jagged piece of slate with a crude skull and crossbones scratched on one side.
The bottle carried a skull and crossbones to warn it was poisonous.

words.trans: n. 一伙人；一帮人（口语，英式/澳式）（Snakey’s lot 斯内基那一伙人/手下）
examples: It's what Snakey's lot call themselves.
That lot at the back of the class never stop talking.

words.trans: （说完一个理由，暗示）还有别的原因
examples: He wouldn't have the guts, for one thing.
I won't go — for one thing, it's too expensive.

words.trans: 给某人通风报信、偷偷报告
examples: By tipping them off about what he had discovered, Tom would be putting everyone in danger.
Someone must have tipped the thieves off about the alarm.

words.trans: v.（机器、马达）发出嗡嗡的旋转声  n. 嗡嗡旋转声
examples: He could hear the whirr of the lawnmower somewhere.
The hard drive gave a soft whirr as it spun up.

words.trans: 侧翻，侧面贴地（飞机机身歪倒，机翼朝下）
examples: The plant was lying on its side, soil scattered over the worktop.
The spilled bottle was lying on its side, leaking across the shelf.

words.trans: n.（厨房）操作台；台面（英式英语）
examples: A handful of soil was scattered over the worktop.
She wiped the worktop clean after preparing dinner.

words.trans: 喉咙发紧。英文小说高频心理描写，用来写人紧张、害怕、哽咽、心里堵得慌，不是生理生病
examples: His throat tightening, he went to find Aunt Emily.
With her throat tightening, she could barely speak.

words.trans: 一阵隐隐的警觉；心头一紧，警觉感袭来
examples: He understood, with a prickle of alarm, that its prevention solely rested on him.
A prickle of alarm ran down her spine when she heard the noise.

words.trans: adv. 仅仅；唯独；只
examples: Its prevention solely rested on him and his friends.
Success depends solely on how hard you work.

words.trans: 短语动词：取决于；依靠；寄托在……身上（solely rested on him 全部都寄托在他身上，唯独要靠他们来完成）
examples: Its prevention solely rested on him and his friends.
The whole decision rests on her shoulders.

words.trans: 非常地道的口语固定表达。没什么大事；真的没事；其实不算什么。用来轻描淡写、掩饰实情，不想把事情说严重、不想引起对方担心
examples: 'Oh, no, it's nothing really.'
'Are you upset?' — 'It's nothing really, don't worry about it.'
